claim: Phase 7 cockpit action UI improved, but this is not a 100/100 claim. The remaining blocker is still a complete end-to-end cockpit proof over a live running multi-agent graph.

implementation.dashboard_action_options: Added pure runtimeControlActionOptions() helper that exposes approve/reject/resume actions only for pending runtime control events.
implementation.dashboard_action_payload: Added buildRuntimeControlActionRequest() helper that targets canonical session_id, task_id, run_id, approval_id, interrupt_id, and resume_token identifiers and stamps dashboard.runtime source metadata.
implementation.runtime_panel_ui: Wired /dashboard/runtime control-event rows to compact lucide icon buttons for approve, reject, and resume, using existing typed API helpers and refreshing the canonical snapshots after a successful action.
implementation.state_boundary: No dashboard-only control truth store was introduced. The UI posts to the existing RuntimeStateStore-backed API contract.

remaining_blockers: No final end-to-end cockpit proof has been recorded that observes a live running multi-agent graph in real time from canonical RuntimeStateStore sources through the dashboard.
PR remains draft and score remains 99/100 until that proof exists and relevant closeout checks pass.
next_patch_sequence: Produce a complete dashboard/API proof that observes a live running multi-agent graph in real time from RuntimeStateStore.
Refresh the all-night artifacts and rerun closeout checks.
Monitor CI for semgrep behavior because local closeout skips semgrep when it is absent on PATH.
